help_player_body: 1. PROFILE 👤 Profile → 🎯 Enter PUBG ID 2. TEAM 👥 My Team → ➕ Create Enter name, tag, avatar, manager Get a code (share with friends) 3. TOURNAMENT 🏆 Tournaments → Pick one 📝 Register → start 4. PAID TOURNAMENT 💳 Payment → Wallet or card If card — send receipt 5. ROOM 🔑 Room info → copy Join room in PUBG Mobile 6. RESULT 📊 Standings → winners ❓ QUESTIONS 💬 Support → write to admin
help_host_body: 1. PANEL SELECTION 🎙 Host panel — regular tournament 📊 Stage panel — stage tournament 2. REGULAR — ROOM Open tournament → 🆔 Send Room ID 🔒 Send password 📨 Or both together: ID: 123456 PASS: abc123 3. STAGE TOURNAMENT — ROOM Stage panel → Pick match Send separate Room for each match 4. RESULT — SCREENSHOT (RECOMMENDED) 📊 Results → 📸 Send screenshot 📌 Requirements: • Screenshot must be CLEAR and CLEAN • Each tag AT LEAST 2 TIMES • Format: #place TAG kill Bot automatically: ✅ Picks tags appearing 2+ times ✅ Sums up kills ✅ Calculates places 5. LEFTOVER TAGS Rare tags go to host: ✏️ Fill manually Format: TAG - KILL Example: UP - 5 N1 - 3 S7 - 2 6. PENALTY Asked per team Enter number (e.g. 5) Or ⏭ Skip Result: Place + Kill − Penalty = Total 7. RESULT — MANUAL 📊 Results → ✏️ Manual input 8. VIEW RESULTS 📊 Results → 📋 Matches 9. SEND MESSAGE 💬 Message participants → text 💡 TIP Send Room info 10 minutes before Take clean and clear screenshots
help_organizer_body: 1. PANEL 🛠 Admin panel → Organizer panel 2. CREATE TOURNAMENT ➕ New tournament Name → type (free/paid) → price → card Image → date → time → mode PRIZE → MAP → Stage → max teams → desc → host ✅ Confirm 3. STAGES Open tournament → 📊 Stages ⚡️ Default or ✏️ Manual 1/4 → 1/2 → Final 4. HOST Match → 🎙 Assign Host 5. PAYMENT ⏳ Pending receipts → ✅ Approve 6. ANNOUNCE Open tournament → 📢 Announce to channel 7. FINISH Open tournament → ✅ Finish
help_admin_body: 1. PANEL 🛠 Admin panel 2. ASSIGN ROLES 🛡 Admins / 🎯 Organizers / 🎙 Hosts ➕ Add → Telegram ID 3. BAN 🚫 Ban system → ➕ / ➖ 4. TOURNAMENT ➕ New tournament or edit 📢 Announce to channel 5. PAYMENTS 💳 Payments → ⏳/✅/❌ 6. CHANNEL 📢 Channel settings → ➕ 7. CARD 💳 Cards → ➕ ⭐ Set default 8. PROMO 🎫 Promo codes → ➕ Type: Percent / Fixed / Free 9. WALLET 💰 Wallet admin Approve Deposit/Withdraw ➕➖ Adjust balance 10. BROADCAST 📢 Broadcast 11. STATS 📊 Statistics 12.
